statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $J\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ an ideal sheaf, $f:X\to Y$ proper, $a:f^*\dashv f_*$ an adjunction, $G$ a coherent formal $J$-system and $F$ coherent on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix $\beta:f^*G\simeq F^\wedge$ and assume $H=f_*F$ coherent. For the canonical quotient projections $\pi^J_n:H\to H/J^{n+1}H$ and $\pi^{J\mathcal O_X}_n:F\to F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F$, let $\kappa:H^\wedge\to f_*(F^\wedge)$ and $\alpha:G\to H^\wedge$ satisfy $\pi^J_n\kappa_n=f_*(\pi^{J\mathcal O_X}_n)$ and $\alpha_n\kappa_n=\eta^a_{G_n}f_*(\beta_n)$ for every $n\geq0$. For an affine open $U\subseteq Y$, put $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$ and $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$, and assume $R$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Set $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$, let $J_0$ be the ideal sheaf of $J(U)R$, and let $g:S\to Y$ be the completion map followed by the inverse affine chart and inclusion. Set $Z=X\times_Y S$, with $p:Z\to S$ and $q:Z\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist $a_R:p^*\dashv p_*$, a coherent formal $J_0$-system $G_0$, coherent $F_0$ on $Z$, an isomorphism $\beta_0:p^*G_0\simeq F_0^\wedge$, coherence of $D_0=p_*F_0$, and maps $\kappa_0:D_0^\wedge\to p_*(F_0^\wedge)$ and $\alpha_0:G_0\to D_0^\wedge$. There is an equality $h_G:G_0=g^*G$ of underlying diagrams and $F_0=q^*F$ as underlying modules; for every $n\geq0$, $\pi^{J_0}_n\kappa_{0,n}=p_*(\pi^{J_0\mathcal O_Z}_n)$ and $\alpha_{0,n}\kappa_{0,n}=\eta^{a_R}_{G_{0,n}}p_*(\beta_{0,n})$. In addition there is an isomorphism $\delta:D_0^\wedge\simeq g^*H^\wedge$ with $\alpha_0\delta=\operatorname{eqToHom}(h_G)g^*\alpha$. No sections or inverse limits are asserted.

proof.text: Construct the coherent pullback objects G₀,F₀ with the exact object equalities, coherence of D, flatness of the chart-completion map, and equality of the extended ideal.
Apply the generic flat transport square theorem to these objects. It constructs adjR, β₀, κ₀, δ and the quotient and unit compatibility squares, without taking α as input.

Define α₀ to have underlying map eqToHom(hG) ⋅ g*α ⋅ δ.inv. The inverse law proves α₀δ=eqToHom(hG)g*α. At each term substitute κ₀=δ g*κ t and cancel δ.inv δ. Functoriality and hα convert the result into the supplied unit square; hence α₀κ₀=η^{adjR}p_*β₀. Package the objects and both equations.

theorem formalComparison_completed_affine_data
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (α : G ⟶ (completion Y J).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj))
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ, α.hom.app (op n) ≫ κ.app (op n) =
      adj.unit.app (G.obj.obj (op n)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (β.hom.app (op n)))
    (U : Y.affineOpens)
    [IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) Γ(Y, U.1))] :
    let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
    let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
    let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)
    let I := (J.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R)
    let J₀ := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom)
    let g : S ⟶ Y := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B R)) ≫
      U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι
    let Z := pullback f g
    let p : Z ⟶ S := pullback.snd f g
    ∃ (adjR : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p)
      (G₀ : CoherentFormalModule S J₀) (F₀ : CoherentModules Z)
      (β₀ : G₀.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (J₀.comap p) F₀.obj)
      (hD : RingedSpace.IsCoherent S.toRingedSpace
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj))
      (κ₀ : formalCompletionSystem J₀ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj) ⟶
        formalCompletionSystem (J₀.comap p) F₀.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p)
      (α₀ : G₀ ⟶ (completion S J₀).obj
        ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj, hD⟩),
      ∃ hG : G₀.obj = G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g,
      F₀.obj = (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F.obj ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ J₀ (n + 1)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj) ≫ κ₀.app (op n) =
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ (J₀.comap p) (n + 1) F₀.obj)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, α₀.hom.app (op n) ≫ κ₀.app (op n) =
        adjR.unit.app (G₀.obj.obj (op n)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map (β₀.hom.app (op n))) ∧
      ∃ δ : ((completion S J₀).obj
          ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj, hD⟩).obj ≅
        ((completion Y J).obj
          ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩).obj ⋙
            Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g,
        α₀.hom ≫ δ.hom = eqToHom hG ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight α.hom (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g)
